brand.name: CV Maker
marketing.eyebrow: Built on a real career-coaching framework
marketing.hero.subtitle: AI is already deciding who gets an interview, before a person ever reads your CV. Build yours with the same framework career coaches use, then get an honest report that shows you exactly why it works, and exactly what to fix if it doesn't.
marketing.pain.title: A recruiter's AI decides if you get an interview, before a person ever reads your CV.
marketing.pain.subtitle: That part isn't going away. The edge now goes to whoever understands how the filter thinks, and pitches their career like they mean it, not whoever stuffed in the most keywords.
marketing.pain.myth.label: What most advice tells you
marketing.pain.reality.label: What actually gets you the interview
marketing.pain.row1.myth: Add more keywords from the job post.
marketing.pain.row1.reality: Pitch your career so the point lands in five seconds, keywords included.
marketing.pain.row2.myth: List every responsibility you ever had.
marketing.pain.row2.reality: Show what you actually achieved, not just what you were assigned to do.
marketing.pain.row3.myth: Hope a nicer-looking template gets you noticed.
marketing.pain.row3.reality: Pass the same six silent objections a real recruiter is already running through.
marketing.pain.row4.myth: Trust a generic AI tool to rewrite your bullet points.
marketing.pain.row4.reality: Get told exactly why a recruiter would stop reading, not just smoother phrasing.
marketing.pain.row5.myth: Apply to more jobs and hope the odds catch up.
marketing.pain.row5.reality: Fix the CV once, then apply to every matching role with confidence.
marketing.framework.title: The same framework career coaches use, built into the product.
marketing.framework.subtitle: Not a generic tips list. A structured method for turning a career history into a CV that survives an AI filter and lands with a human, then carrying that same thinking to everywhere else you're visible.
marketing.framework.step1.title: Get evaluated
marketing.framework.step1.body: Your CV is checked against six real objections a recruiter runs through in the first five seconds, not a vague keyword score.
marketing.framework.step2.title: Understand why
marketing.framework.step2.body: Every result comes with plain reasoning: what's working, what's not, and why it matters for this exact role.
marketing.framework.step3.title: Fix what matters most
marketing.framework.step3.body: Priority actions ranked by impact, so you fix the one change that actually moves the needle, first.
marketing.framework.step4.title: Take it further
marketing.framework.step4.body: Pro includes the full coaching guide: the same method, applied to your LinkedIn profile and how you network.
marketing.pricing.title: One free plan. One upgrade. No surprises.
marketing.pricing.subtitle: Every account can build and export unlimited CVs, free, with a small watermark. Upgrade any time to remove it, unlock premium templates, and get unlimited access to the CV Optimizer and the full coaching guide.
marketing.testimonials.title: People who used this exact framework to land interviews
marketing.testimonials.subtitle: Career coaching clients who rebuilt their CV around the same method now built into CV Maker.
marketing.testimonials.t1.quote: I'd sent over forty applications with barely a reply. The report showed me my CV read like a job description, not a track record. I rewrote my top three bullets around what I actually shipped and got two interview calls the same week.
marketing.testimonials.t2.quote: The six objections sound simple until you see your own CV fail three of them. Fixing the story, not just the wording, is what actually changed things for me.
marketing.testimonials.t3.quote: I was moving from hospitality into project management with no matching job title to show for it. The framework helped me pitch my experience like it belonged there, and it worked.
marketing.testimonials.t4.quote: Healthcare CVs don't usually get this kind of attention. The report caught that I'd buried my actual responsibilities under a wall of certifications. Reordering it made a real difference.
marketing.testimonials.t5.quote: No experience, no idea what recruiters wanted. The report told me exactly which university project to lead with, and why. I landed my first interview two weeks later.
marketing.testimonials.t6.quote: I always led with numbers, but the report showed my CV read as noise, ten metrics with no story connecting them. Cutting it down to the three that mattered got recruiters actually replying.
marketing.testimonials.t7.quote: Moving from audit into FP&A felt like starting over on paper. The framework showed me which parts of my audit work already counted as FP&A experience, I just wasn't saying it that way.
marketing.testimonials.t8.quote: Hotel management doesn't translate well to a CV built for offices. The report helped me show the actual scale I was running, not just "guest services".
marketing.testimonials.t9.quote: I was moving from teaching into corporate training and had no idea how to make fifteen years in a classroom sound relevant. It did, once I knew which parts to lead with.
marketing.features.title: One framework, built into every part of the platform
marketing.features.subtitle: Not four separate tools bolted together. The same career-coaching method runs through your templates, your report, and how you learn it.
marketing.features.atsHuman.title: ATS-friendly and human-driven, never one instead of the other
marketing.features.atsHuman.body: Every template parses cleanly for the software screening your CV first, and still reads like a real career story for the person who opens it next.
marketing.features.coachingTemplates.tit: Coaching-verified templates, for a story that lands
marketing.features.coachingTemplates.bod: Eight layouts, each built around the same structure real career coaches teach, so your experience reads as a coherent story a recruiter can follow in five seconds, not a list of job titles.
marketing.features.optimizerReport.title: Know exactly what works, what doesn't, and why
marketing.features.optimizerReport.body: A recruiter, a career coach, and a resume writer independently score your CV against the exact role you're applying for, then hand you a blunt pass or reject verdict, plus the priority fixes ranked by impact. Not a percentage you're left to guess at.
marketing.features.academy.title: The method behind the platform, not just the tool
marketing.features.academy.body: The same framework that powers your CV Optimizer report, taught step by step: how to structure a CV, optimize a LinkedIn profile, and network with intention, the way real career coaches teach it.
marketing.cta.title: Your next interview starts with a CV that earns it.
marketing.cta.body: It takes about ten minutes to build. It's free to start, and free to finish.

pricing.faq.title: Common questions
pricing.faq.q1: Is the free plan really free?
pricing.faq.a1: Yes. There's no trial period and no credit card required to sign up, build a CV, or export it as a watermarked PDF.
pricing.faq.q2: What does the watermark look like?
pricing.faq.a2: A small, discreet "Made with CV Maker" mark in the page footer, never over your content.
pricing.faq.q3: Can I cancel Pro at any time?
pricing.faq.a3: Yes, from your account at any time. You keep Pro access until the end of the period you already paid for.
pricing.faq.q4: What's actually included in the coaching guide?
pricing.faq.a4: The same framework used in real career coaching sessions: how to structure a CV, how to read and respond to a job description, how to optimize a LinkedIn profile, and how to network with intention. It's included with Pro.

optimizer.detail.rewrite.pitch: Apply the fixes above directly to your CV — the summary and experience bullets get rewritten, everything else stays as it is.
optimizer.detail.rewrite.ineligible: Your score is too low for a rewrite to help. That can mean this role is a real stretch for your experience, or simply that your CV doesn't have enough concrete detail yet for a rewrite to work with — either way, a rewrite only sharpens facts that are already there, it never invents ones that aren't. Fill in more detail below, or work through the critical gaps above, then run a new report.
